close_reason: Native Enum run/build paths execute cleanly; runtime helper domains are explicit, negative intervals are total, diagnostics remain sensitive to genuine user partiality, and focused/static gates pass.
description:
Signal: cargo test --test fz2_cli fails on Enum fixtures. After the fz-k22.14/.18/.20/.22 fold, the old Cranelift verifier failure is gone, but native_enum_take_positive_single_call_survives_reduction_yield reaches runtime and aborts in fz_closure_get_capture_ref: capture index 1 reads raw tag ValueKind(0), word 0x2.

Root cause repaired by the folded work: executable/transport symbols preserve ActivationKey.arrow; capture groundings and callable entry identity now cross transport.

Remaining blocker: fz-k22.23. A shared consumer body cannot select one static callable-entry stamp when its argument remains type-variable; it must dispatch through the value-carried entry identity. The integration full-library gate currently has ten failures in the affected direct-only/boundary assertions and native closure paths. The user-owned regression test src/compiler2/drive_test.rs::compiler2_native_enum_take_closure_constructors_match_entry_capture_counts passes, proving construction counts align; the crash is later invocation/dispatch.

Goal: restore JIT and AOT execution for the existing fz2 Enum fixture contracts without suppressing diagnostics or relaxing the CLI tests.

Verification after fz-k22.23: enum_take_positive_single, enum_take_drop_split, and enum_predicate_search run/build; the constructor capture-count test; cargo test --test fz2_cli; cargo test --lib; strict clippy.

comments.text: fz-k22.20 deletion audit: `enum_take_drop_split` reaches a source publication position for CallableId(19) with BoundaryIds(4,5), but BoundaryId(4) still owns two concrete entries (targets 162/163) with the same physical ABI. Native now correctly refuses to invent a code pointer. The missing fact is upstream: publication must carry one exact callable-entry identity, or semantic/transport must split this pooled multi-specialization value before packaging. No native fallback or target/type re-selection remains.

title: Repair native Enum callable ABI regressions exposed by fz2 CLI
